summary: Nodes stuck in "Validating" during Dedicated pool expansion (post-provision validations failing/timeouting)
body:
Customer: HelioLogic (Dedicated)

Issue summary
- During a planned Dedicated pool expansion in us-east (A100), newly provisioned nodes were successfully allocated and joined the Kubernetes cluster but remained in readiness state "Validating" for >45 minutes, preventing them from joining the serving pool.
- Fleet readiness showed repeated post-provision validation failures/timeouts for the NCCL smoke test step and (in a smaller subset) perf canary step.

Impact
- Capacity shortfall during expansion window; temporary drop in available throughput on the customer’s Dedicated pool.
- No full outage, but elevated queueing/latency as autoscaling could not add the new nodes.

Customer-reported symptoms
- "Pool scale-up initiated but new nodes never become Ready; console shows Validating for an hour+".
- Noted increased p95 latency and occasional request timeouts during peak.

Environment
- prod / us-east
- Dedicated pool: helio-logic-dedicated-a100 (internal pool id: dp-7c1f)
- Image channel at time of failures: candidate (gpu-worker-2025.10.10-candidate)

Timeline (UTC)
- 2025-10-11 16:22: Customer opened ticket reporting expansion delay.
- 2025-10-11 16:34: Support acknowledged; SRE looped in (#incidents, #eng-infra).
- 2025-10-11 17:10: Initial triage: nodes stuck in "Validating" with repeated postflight NCCL failures/timeouts.
- 2025-10-12 00:40: Workaround applied: reimage affected nodes to stable channel + re-run validations.
- 2025-10-13: Engineering root-caused validation agent timeout behavior + flaky NCCL invocation.
- 2025-10-16: Fix merged (PR-18481) and rolled to us-east validation agent.
- 2025-10-18: Ticket resolved after successful expansion retry; no further stuck nodes observed.

Triage notes / Investigation
- Fleet readiness service showed nodes progressing through:
  Allocated -> Provisioning -> JoinedCluster -> Validating
  then repeatedly failing: postflight.nccl_smoketest

- Observed failure modes:
  1) NCCL smoke test: timeout / hang leading to repeated retries without a clear terminal failure reason.
  2) A small subset: perf canary failed due to missing warmup and network jitter (single-digit occurrences; not the majority).

- Dashboards used:
  - Provision-to-ready dashboard: "Step breakdown" for us-east + A100 (Validating step tail latency spike)
  - Failure heatmap by step: postflight.nccl_smoketest dominated failures

- Per-runbook guidance:
  Followed Confluence runbook "Provision-to-ready failures triage" sections:
  - "Validating stuck > 20m"
  - "NCCL smoke test failures"
  - "Safe remediation order: drain -> quarantine (if needed) -> reimage"

Log excerpts (sanitized)
- Validation agent (node-validation-agent) logs:
  2025-10-11T16:58:12Z INFO  step=postflight.nccl_smoketest attempt=1 timeout_s=300 cmd="/opt/redwood/bin/nccl-smoke --allreduce --min-bytes=256M --max-bytes=1G"
  2025-10-11T17:03:13Z WARN  step=postflight.nccl_smoketest result=timeout elapsed_s=301 exit_code=124
  2025-10-11T17:03:13Z INFO  step=postflight.nccl_smoketest attempt=2 backoff_s=5
  2025-10-11T17:08:20Z WARN  step=postflight.nccl_smoketest result=timeout elapsed_s=305 exit_code=124
  2025-10-11T17:08:20Z ERROR step=postflight.nccl_smoketest message="timeout; retrying" node=ip-10-44-18-203

- Fleet readiness state summary (API):
  state=Validating
  last_failed_step=postflight.nccl_smoketest
  failure_reason=VALIDATION_TIMEOUT
  artifacts=s3://redwood-internal-readiness/us-east/dp-7c1f/<node-id>/postflight.nccl_smoketest.log

- Perf canary (subset):
  2025-10-11T18:11:09Z ERROR step=postflight.perf_canary message="p95 > threshold" observed_p95_ms=410 threshold_ms=300 model=llama-3.1-70b

Workaround applied (customer-impact mitigation)
- For nodes stuck in Validating > 20 minutes:
  1) Drain node from k8s (if scheduled)
  2) Reimage to stable image channel: gpu-worker-2025.10.12-stable
  3) Re-run provisioning validations (orchestrator retry)
  4) Only then allow node to join serving pool

- Result:
  Reimaged nodes passed validation and became Ready within ~18 minutes (P95) after reimage.

Root cause
- Validation agent behavior under NCCL test hang/timeout was insufficiently defensive:
  - timeouts were applied, but retries could re-enter the same condition with minimal backoff
  - failure reporting was not consistently persisted, making nodes appear "Validating" rather than failing fast to Quarantined/terminal state

Fix
- Engineering shipped updated validation agent timeouts/retry behavior and improved log bundling and terminal failure signaling:
  - GitHub: PR-18481 ("harden validation agent timeouts and retries")
  - Also leveraged ongoing work to record validation artifacts and failure reasons centrally (PR-18429)

Resolution
- After rolling PR-18481 to us-east and pinning the pool image channel back to stable for expansion, the next expansion attempt completed successfully.
- No new nodes remained stuck in Validating beyond the expected window; NCCL smoke test failure rate returned to baseline.

Customer communication (external)
- We confirmed this was an internal provisioning validation issue impacting scale-up time, not an application-side configuration problem.
- We recommended (and executed on our side) a reimage of affected nodes and a stable image channel pin for the remainder of the expansion.

Follow-ups / Action items
- (Eng) Tune NCCL smoke test parameters for us-east A100 to reduce flakes and avoid long hangs (captured in Linear backlog; referenced in #eng-infra).
- (SRE) Alerting: ensure "Validating stuck" pages only when it correlates with capacity impact; otherwise ticket-only during rollout.
- (Infra) Staged rollout guardrails: keep candidate image channel off for customer expansions unless explicitly approved.

Comments (highlights)
- 2025-10-11 (Support -> SRE): "Seeing 12/20 new nodes stuck in Validating; last_failed_step is NCCL. Any known issue with candidate image?"
- 2025-10-12 (Infra): "Proceeding with reimage to stable; will quarantine repeat offenders after 2 attempts per runbook."
- 2025-10-16 (Eng): "PR-18481 merged; rollout to us-east validation agent tonight, then retry expansion." 
- 2025-10-18 (Support): "Customer confirmed expansion completed; closing ticket."
